# Vendored third-party assets (served locally so the CSP can stay `self`)

| Asset | Version | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| vis-network (`vis-network.min.js`, standalone UMD) | 9.1.9 | Apache-2.0 OR MIT | npm `vis-network` |
| Nunito 700/800 (latin woff2) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | npm `@fontsource/nunito` |
| Inter 400/500/600 (latin woff2) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | npm `@fontsource/inter` |
| Gaegu 700 (latin woff2) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | npm `@fontsource/gaegu` |

Icons and the mascot are inline SVG / local SVG files drawn for this project.
To upgrade: `npm i vis-network@X @fontsource/...` in a scratch folder and copy the files here.
